meaning: to divide up; to partition; to classify

senses.en: to divide up; to partition; to classify

examples.zh: 学校把学生划分成三个班。
examples.en: The school divided the students into three classes.

examples.zh: 城市被划分成几个区。
examples.en: The city is divided into several districts.

examples.zh: 怎么划分工作，大家还没决定。
examples.en: How to divide up the work hasn't been decided yet.

meaning: to increase in number; to grow more numerous

senses.en: to increase in number; to grow more numerous

note: About countable things (people, cases); for amounts, use 增加.

examples.zh: 最近感冒的人增多了。
examples.en: More people have caught colds lately.

examples.zh: 游客增多，酒店都满了。
examples.en: Tourists have increased, and the hotels are all full.

examples.zh: 年纪大了，白头发增多了。
examples.en: With age, I have more gray hair.

meaning: to be opposed; to stand in opposition

senses.en: to be opposed; to stand in opposition

note: Collocations: 意见对立, 对立面.

examples.zh: 他们两个人的意见对立。
examples.en: The two of them hold opposing views.

examples.zh: 别把工作和生活对立起来。
examples.en: Don't set work and life against each other.

examples.zh: 两家公司长期对立，很少合作。
examples.en: The two companies have long been rivals and rarely cooperate.

meaning: nationality; citizenship

senses.en: nationality; citizenship

examples.zh: 请填你的国籍。
examples.en: Please fill in your nationality.

examples.zh: 他的国籍是美国，但住在越南。
examples.en: His nationality is American, but he lives in Vietnam.

examples.zh: 办签证时要写清楚国籍。
examples.en: When applying for a visa, write your nationality clearly.

meaning: notice (posted or published), e.g. lost-and-found or job notice

senses.en: notice (posted or published), e.g. lost-and-found or job notice

note: Notices often come as 招聘启事 (job) and 寻物启事 (lost item).

examples.zh: 我在门口看到一张启事。
examples.en: I saw a notice at the door.

examples.zh: 他丢了手机，就贴了启事。
examples.en: He lost his phone, so he put up a notice.

examples.zh: 请看门口的启事。
examples.en: Please read the notice at the door.

meaning: to be willing to part with or spend; not to begrudge

senses.en: to be willing to part with or spend; not to begrudge

note: Usually negative or a question: 舍不得 means unwilling to part with.

examples.zh: 她不舍得扔旧衣服。
examples.en: She can't bear to throw away old clothes.

examples.zh: 你舍得把新车借给我吗？
examples.en: Are you willing to lend me your new car?

examples.zh: 孩子要出国了，妈妈很不舍得。
examples.en: The child is going abroad, and Mom hates to let go.

meaning: indicator; target figure; quota

senses.en: indicator; target figure; quota

examples.zh: 医生说我的身体指标都正常。
examples.en: The doctor said my health indicators are all normal.

examples.zh: 公司今年的销售指标很高。
examples.en: The company's sales target this year is high.

examples.zh: 体检的各项指标都不错。
examples.en: All the indicators in the checkup are good.

meaning: appearance; look (of a place or thing); face

senses.en: appearance; look (of a place or thing); face

note: Often about places: 城市面貌, 精神面貌.

examples.zh: 这个城市的面貌变化很大。
examples.en: The look of this city has changed a lot.

examples.zh: 十年后，这里的面貌完全不同了。
examples.en: Ten years later, this place looks completely different.

examples.zh: 他的精神面貌很好。
examples.en: He looks full of spirit.

meaning: written agreement; protocol

senses.en: written agreement; protocol

note: A signed document: 签协议书.

examples.zh: 请在协议书上签字。
examples.en: Please sign the agreement.

examples.zh: 这份协议书我还没看完。
examples.en: I haven't finished reading this agreement.

examples.zh: 租房子的协议书要保存好。
examples.en: Keep the rental agreement safe.

meaning: according to the law; in accordance with the law

senses.en: according to the law; in accordance with the law

note: Formal; adverb before the verb: 依法纳税, 依法处理.

examples.zh: 做生意要依法办事。
examples.en: Doing business must be done by the law.

examples.zh: 新闻说警察依法处理了这件事。
examples.en: The news says the police handled this by law.

examples.zh: 开饭馆必须依法办理手续。
examples.en: Opening a restaurant requires going through the procedures by law.

meaning: to advocate; to promote (a practice)

senses.en: to advocate; to promote (a practice)

examples.zh: 学校提倡学生多运动。
examples.en: The school encourages students to exercise more.

examples.zh: 现在城市提倡大家坐公共汽车。
examples.en: Cities now encourage everyone to take the bus.

examples.zh: 他提倡大家少开车。
examples.en: He urges everyone to drive less.

meaning: one after another; in succession; order of precedence

senses.en: one after another; in succession; order of precedence

note: Two uses: adverb (他们先后到) or noun (有先后 order).

examples.zh: 他们先后来到北京。
examples.en: They came to Beijing one after another.

examples.zh: 客人先后到了。
examples.en: The guests arrived one after another.

examples.zh: 这两件事的先后顺序要弄清楚。
examples.en: Make clear the order of these two things.

meaning: to transfer (ownership of a shop, house, right)

senses.en: to transfer (ownership of a shop, house, right)

note: Shops often put up 转让 signs when the owner hands over the business.

examples.zh: 他把店转让给朋友了。
examples.en: He transferred the shop to a friend.

examples.zh: 这套房子能转让吗？
examples.en: Can this flat be transferred?

examples.zh: 这家店要转让，你有兴趣吗？
examples.en: This shop is up for transfer. Are you interested?

meaning: expo; fair (large exhibition)

senses.en: expo; fair (large exhibition)

examples.zh: 我去参观了食品博览会。
examples.en: I visited the food expo.

examples.zh: 这次博览会有很多国家参加。
examples.en: Many countries take part in this expo.

examples.zh: 博览会的门票贵不贵？
examples.en: Are tickets to the expo expensive?

meaning: food and beverage; catering

senses.en: food and beverage; catering

note: Industry word: 餐饮业, 餐饮店.

examples.zh: 他在餐饮行业工作。
examples.en: He works in the catering industry.

examples.zh: 这条街上餐饮店很多。
examples.en: There are many food and drink shops on this street.

examples.zh: 旅游季，餐饮生意特别好。
examples.en: In the tourist season, the food business is especially good.

meaning: to learn the basics; introductory (level)

senses.en: to learn the basics; introductory (level)

note: As a noun modifier: 汉语入门 means Chinese for beginners.

examples.zh: 这本书适合汉语入门的人。
examples.en: This book suits people starting Chinese.

examples.zh: 学游泳，先要入门。
examples.en: To learn swimming, first get the basics.

examples.zh: 他刚入门，还需要多练习。
examples.en: He's just started and still needs more practice.

meaning: not easy; difficult

senses.en: not easy; difficult

note: Written; spoken equivalent is 不容易.

examples.zh: 找到好工作很不易。
examples.en: It's not easy to find a good job.

examples.zh: 在国外生活，真不易。
examples.en: Living abroad is really hard.

examples.zh: 养孩子不易，你辛苦了。
examples.en: Raising a child isn't easy. You've worked hard.

meaning: craft; technique of making things

senses.en: craft; technique of making things

examples.zh: 这个杯子的工艺很复杂。
examples.en: The craft behind this cup is very complex.

examples.zh: 他在学传统工艺。
examples.en: He is learning a traditional craft.

examples.zh: 这种工艺已经有几百年历史了。
examples.en: This craft has a history of several hundred years.

meaning: head of a group (tour group, delegation, group-buy)

senses.en: head of a group (tour group, delegation, group-buy)

note: In community group-buying, the 团长 collects orders and hands out goods.

examples.zh: 这次旅游的团长是谁？
examples.en: Who is the leader of this tour group?

examples.zh: 我们的团长对大家很热情。
examples.en: Our group leader is warm to everyone.

examples.zh: 我邻居是社区的团长，可以帮大家订菜。
examples.en: My neighbor organizes the group buy here and can order vegetables for everyone.

meaning: dictionary

senses.en: dictionary

note: Same as 词典; 辞典 sounds more formal or bookish.

examples.zh: 我想买一本汉语辞典。
examples.en: I want to buy a Chinese dictionary.

examples.zh: 不懂的词，可以查辞典。
examples.en: For words you don't know, you can look in a dictionary.

examples.zh: 这本辞典有很多例子。
examples.en: This dictionary has many examples.
